content.text:
Yes, it's herdr. You're running Claude inside herdr 0.9.3 (`TERM_PROGRAM=herdr`), and herdr plays a sound by default whenever an agent changes state in a background workspace:

- **"done"** when an agent finishes a turn.
- **"request"** when an agent needs your input, such as a permission prompt.

This comes from herdr's `[ui.sound]` section, which defaults to `enabled = true`. Your config in `modules/home-manager/herdr.nix` never sets it, so you get the default. It probably started "suddenly" because you started running Claude under herdr on 2026-10-09, when it was integrated. The sound isn't from Claude Code itself. Your `settings.json` change only switches the model.

Two other things are on but probably aren't the beep:
- `ui.toast.delivery = "terminal"` (line 94) sends herdr's notification popups out to WezTerm. Depending on your WezTerm bell setup, that could also make a noise.
- `agentPushNotifEnabled: true` in `config/claude/settings.json` is a Claude Code push-notification setting, not an audible bell.

To silence it, add one of these to the herdr `settings` in `herdr.nix`:

```nix
ui.sound.enabled = false;            # no sounds at all
# or, to mute only Claude:
ui.sound.agents.claude = "off";
```

Then run `make switch` and `herdr server reload-config`. I've assumed the per-agent key is `claude`, based on the `droid` example in herdr's defaults. I haven't checked it. I can make the change if you tell me which option you want.
